text:
## Step 7: Ongoing Monitoring  
### Post-Screening Monitoring  
**High-Risk Customers:**
- Quarterly re-screening (re-scan sanctions lists)
- Enhanced transaction monitoring
- Unusual activity alerts reviewed manually
- Annual comprehensive risk review  
**Standard-Risk Customers:**
- Annual re-screening (re-scan sanctions lists)
- Automated transaction monitoring
- Alerts reviewed by automated rules  
**Monitoring Triggers:**
- Large transaction (>£50,000)
- Transaction to high-risk jurisdiction
- New beneficiary or payee
- Rapid transaction velocity (multiple in short time)

raw_entities.description: Post-screening continuous monitoring process for customer accounts, differentiated by risk classification. Includes periodic re-screening of sanctions lists, transaction monitoring (enhanced or automated based on risk level), and manual or automated review of alerts triggered by defined monitoring criteria.

raw_entities.description: Quarterly re-scan of sanctions lists for customers classified as high-risk, as part of ongoing AML monitoring obligations.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Enhanced Transaction Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Intensive monitoring of transactions on high-risk customer accounts to detect suspicious or unusual activity patterns.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Unusual Activity Alert Review
raw_entities.description: Manual review of unusual activity alerts generated for high-risk customer accounts as part of enhanced monitoring procedures.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Annual Comprehensive Risk Review
raw_entities.description: Annual comprehensive reassessment of risk profile for high-risk customers, incorporating findings from ongoing monitoring activities.

raw_entities.description: Annual re-scan of sanctions lists for customers classified as standard-risk, as part of ongoing AML monitoring obligations.

raw_entities.description: Automated monitoring of transactions on standard-risk customer accounts using predefined rules to identify suspicious patterns.

raw_entities.description: Automated review and processing of transaction monitoring alerts for standard-risk customers using predefined rule sets.

raw_entities.name: Large Transaction Detection
raw_entities.description: Monitoring trigger activated when a transaction exceeds £50,000, flagging the transaction for enhanced scrutiny and potential alert generation.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Jurisdiction Transaction Detection
raw_entities.description: Monitoring trigger activated when a transaction is directed to or originates from a high-risk jurisdiction, requiring enhanced review.

raw_entities.name: New Beneficiary or Payee Detection
raw_entities.description: Monitoring trigger activated when a customer initiates a transaction to a new beneficiary or payee not previously recorded on the account.

raw_entities.name: Rapid Transaction Velocity Detection
raw_entities.description: Monitoring trigger activated when multiple transactions occur in a short time period, indicating unusual transaction velocity that may signal suspicious activity.
context: Rapid transaction velocity (multiple in short time)

raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate ensuring periodic re-screening of customer records against current sanctions lists (quarterly for high-risk, annually for standard-risk customers) as required by AML regulations.
